mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) increases tacrolimus nephrotoxicity and risk of arrhythmias; both drugs are nephrotoxic and loop diuretics reduce tacrolimus levels through volume depletion.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and tacrolimus levels closely; consider potassium-sparing agent or reduced diuretic dosing; maintain euvolemia to optimize tacrolimus clearance.
